equivalent_groups.reason: Canvas normalizes units to the literal values 'in' or 'mm'; identity and lexical-less-than-or-equal substitutions select the same branch for exactly that two-value domain.
Pillow clamps negative RGBA channels to zero; these negative-channel substitutions decode to the same transparent-black initial surface.
RGB values beneath alpha zero in a temporary source-over layer are unobservable; Pillow clamps negative channels and alpha-compositing discards hidden RGB.

The validated supersample domain is the integers 1 through 8; all three substitutions resize exactly when supersample is greater than one or perform a same-size Pillow resize at one, which is pixel-identical.

PNG optimize changes only valid lossless encoding choices; the contract requires deterministic bytes for repeated identical inputs, which both settings satisfy, and decoded RGBA pixels and metadata are identical.
Rectangle and regular-polygon radii, dash offsets, and stroke widths are validated nonnegative, making != 0 and > 0 identical predicates over their reachable domains.
The only valid nondefault line caps are 'round' and 'square', both lexically greater than 'butt'; therefore != 'butt' and > 'butt' reject the same reachable values.
Validated colors are 'none' or seven-character hexadecimal strings, validated opacity is in [0,1], and slicing a seven-character string at index 7 or 8 yields the same blue channel.
